header: Which calculator page needs the wide box of the search bar. When a form's ui.tsx says `wide: true` (src/tools/uiTypes.ts), its page is cramped in the normal width (the PF page: three boxes in a row, and a table of years); I then give the box exactly the width that an Executive Deep Synthesis answer with a table of 4 or more columns gets (src/lib/search/edsLayout.ts): the width of the page behind it. This is a pure function of the form that is open, so the box returns to its normal width the moment the form is closed. This file names no topic: it only reads the list of topics.

symbols.name: toolFormIsWide
symbols.sig: export function toolFormIsWide(form: string | null | undefined): boolean

symbols.name: toolFormMaxRem
symbols.sig: export function toolFormMaxRem(form: string | null | undefined): number | null
doc: The largest width in rem that a form's page asks for (never more than the page itself). I return null when it asks for the page's whole width, or for nothing.

behaviours: the PF page asks for the wide box, and for a width of its own in rem (PF_BOX_REM), which follows the text size and the zoom and is never more than the page
no other form, the menu or no form asks for a width in rem
no other calculator page does (gratuity, leave encashment, dates, converter, tyre, EV, VIN, BH, calculator), nor the menu, nor no form
exactly one form asks for the wide box today

the omnibar's wide switch is the Deep Synthesis rule OR a table of 4+ columns in an answer card OR a form that asks for the wide box; a page with its own width gets min(rem, the page, 100%), every other wide box is the page's width
the shared omnibar file names no topic for this (no 'pf' in the width rule)
a table of 4 columns is where the Deep Synthesis box turns wide (the same rule the PF page now follows)
